thread:
sam: quick FYI: while updating a dashboard guide I hit a confusing behavior: the dashboard example shows `cacheTTL: 0` to demonstrate no caching, but running the same config on staging still shows KV cache hits for ~25s. are we sure 0 still disables caching?

nora: good catch. runtime changed how it serializes absent values last quarter. 0 might be treated as omitted by the SDK shim and the runtime falls back to default TTL. which doc page is this on?

sam: docs/console/observability/kvcache.md (line ~88) — snippet is small:
```yaml
dashboard:
  kvCache:
    enabled: true
    cacheTTL: 0  # intended to disable
```

liam: iirc, we changed proto semantics in runtime v2.5 so numeric 0 is not distinguishable from missing in the JSON payload unless we use nullable field. SDKs started mapping 0 -> omit. Not great for examples.

sam: so what do we change? make the example use `cacheTTL: null`? add a note about runtime versions?

ryan: yes, update the snippet to `cacheTTL: null` and add a short compatibility note: older runtimes (< v2.5) treat 0 as disable, newer runtimes require null. also add a tiny CI sample test to catch this going forward.

liam: i can add the CI test as a follow-up if someone lands the docs change. the test would render the page and validate the generated API payload contains `cacheTTL: null` when docs show null. tiny python script should do.

nora: i'll take the PR. will also fix the anchor id that linter flags sometimes. opening branch now.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 — title: "Console/KV cache: make disablement explicit; note runtime compatibility". added the snippet change and a migration blurb in docs/migrations/runtime-nullability.md.

ci-bot: link-check: failure — 1 broken anchor in console/observability/kvcache.md (line 102).

nora: ack, fixed anchor and pushed another commit. also clarified wording: "Use cacheTTL: null to disable caching on runtime >= v2.5. For runtime < v2.5, 0 disables caching."

ci-bot: preview build deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr/4721 — checks: linter ok, link-check pending.

docs-bot: link-check: passed.

liam: LGTM, small nit: the migration note references `legacyZeroTtl: true` as a runtime fallback flag. in our public docs we should show snake_case `legacy_zero_ttl` (matches other flags). can we unify?\

nora: good call. changed the example flag to `legacy_zero_ttl` in the migration snippet. pushed.

sam: merged PR 4721 — thanks all. backport to release/2.x opened as #4723.

ryan: created runtime issue to add integration smoke test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1901 — assigned to eng-runtime triage.

liam: leaving a follow-up to add the unit in the docs linter that validates anchors and snippet ids; pushed an issue in docs repo.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll add a short note to the release notes about the docs clarification so users don't misconfigure. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
